additional_concerns: The constant TRUE result is defensible only within the expressly selected rival reading. It does not resolve whether footnote 5 inherits paragraph 14's request condition, establish completed demonstration, or establish SFC satisfaction.
The TRUE_IS_SATISFIED convention must retain the question's DUTY_TRIGGER meaning; activation is not compliance.

Effective accountability requires an applicable assessment standard and actual evidence of authority and conduct. Neither a register-maintenance allocation nor the valuation supervision provision supplies a complete tokenisation safe harbour.
The separate intermediary issuance provision supports responsibility notwithstanding outsourcing within its own scope; it does not automatically establish the Product Provider's compliance.
Paragraph 15's third-party audit request and paragraph 16's legal-opinion request are separate triggers. Neither follows automatically from minimum demonstration activation.
The supplied structural and retrieval checks establish neither legal interpretation nor factual compliance.
